clauses.clause: a failed verification demotes a model (check)
retire a refuted model that has no reactivatable predecessor

rows.remains: Not built, by decision. Retiring a refuted model with no predecessor needs a log record the promoted set (apply_promotion/resume_model_promotions) and the Model Pack lineage (ModelPack::succeed/packs_of) both replay. ModelPromotion is a signed, schema-locked body (event_fabric_schema_lock, schemas.lock.json): a retire flag changes its shape and needs a lock edit, a new topic needs the same, and overloading displaced==[own reference] as 'retire' changes what replayed records mean without a decision record. That is a person's call (an ADR, then the lock edit). Clause (3), examining subjects other than the round's own, is also open.

clauses.clause: thousands of specialist/temporary models compete from a composition root
clauses.test: none drives a full Platform cycle to a spawn

rows.remains: Not built. Production spawns at most one temporary per subject, so 'thousands' needs a per-entity forecaster seam: how many forecasters per cycle, at what compute cost against COMPUTE_BUDGET and the 4,096 cap, is a design and figure decision I would be inventing. The register already names the same missing seam as R12-MODEL-3089.

rows.remains: Not built. ModelCard carries no uncertainty measurement and no calibration-error measurement or ceiling (only a pass/fail PROMOTION_TESTS calibration result), so the limit at which either becomes a finding is a figure I would have to invent (NEEDS_FIGURE). Separately the decision-time caller of ModelRiskRegister::admit needs the ADR the register names (which decision seam asks it).
